proposals.reason: First CRA standards published, establishing vocabulary and lifecycle principles for digital products.

card.x: EN 40000-1-1 (cybersecurity vocabulary) and EN 40000-1-2 (lifecycle principles) published as first CRA foundations. Medical devices with equivalent sectoral rules (MDR cybersecurity) may be excluded.

proposals.reason: Deadline confirmed for registration of all existing devices; industry advised to complete by 27 Nov (Friday) to avoid weekend complications.

card.x: All devices on market before 28 May 2026 must be registered in EUDAMED. Register by Friday 27 Nov to avoid weekend complications. National organizational data must be updated by 31 Dec 2026 for 2027 surveillance fees.

proposals.reason: MDCG revised position paper clarifying SS(C)P summary management in EUDAMED after mandatory use.

card.x: Revised guidance clarifies workflow for uploading SS(C)P summaries in EUDAMED after mandatory use. No new deadlines beyond existing obligations.

proposals.reason: Amendment to IEC 60601-2-4 for cardiac defibrillators published, may affect safety and performance requirements.

card.x: Amendment A2 to cardiac defibrillator safety standard published. Review for changes to design, testing, or labeling requirements. Transition date pending OJEU publication.

proposals.reason: Amendment to IEC 60601-2-28 for X-ray tube assemblies published, may affect diagnostic imaging devices.

card.x: Amendment A1 to X-ray tube assembly standard published. Review for changes to safety and essential performance requirements for diagnostic imaging.

proposals.reason: New Part 3 of ISO 11607 published, defining criteria for developing forming, sealing and assembly processes for sterile MD packaging.

card.x: Part 3 defines methodology for designing and developing forming, sealing and assembly processes for sterile MD packaging systems. Verify process documentation against new criteria. Check OJEU for harmonized status.
